subject: Intro: MAP starter briefing & timeline confirmation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novagenhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Intro: MAP starter briefing & timeline confirmation

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a concise evaluation timeline so your team can hit a pilot decision within the quarter. I attached a lightweight MAP worksheet to make this simple.

High-level proposal (suggested, happy to adapt):
- Primary goal: validate Redwood Inference for latent clinical-document extraction (reduce manual review by 60% on pilot dataset)
- Success criteria: 1) Precision >= 0.88 on priority set, 2) end-to-end latency < 350ms for typical requests, 3) integration feasibility with your staging pipeline
- Timeline: 6-week eval (week 0: kickoff & infra prep; weeks 1–4: ingest + iter; week 5: validation; week 6: decision/pilot sign-off)
- Key stakeholders (please confirm): Samantha (Product Champion), Michael Dunn (Engineering lead), Elena Rossi (Procurement / contracts)

What I need from you to finalize the MAP: a) confirm the stakeholders above and who will own each success criterion, b) confirm ability to provide a small representative dataset and access details for a staging environment, and c) pick one 30-minute slot next week for a kickoff. Proposed times (PT): Tue Aug 3 10:00–10:30, Wed Aug 4 11:00–11:30, or Thu Aug 5 14:00–14:30.

I've attached: redwood_map_starter.xlsx (MAP worksheet) — fill the stakeholder/ownership column and return, and the short checklist for infra hints.

If you prefer, Mina (cc'd) will run the kickoff and handle the technical onboarding once stakeholders are confirmed — she'll lead the ingestion checklist and SSO/KMS questions.

Looking forward — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_map_starter.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novagenhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Michael Dunn <michael.dunn@novagenhealth.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novagenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 17:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro: MAP starter briefing & timeline confirmation

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and aligned with what we've discussed internally. Quick answers:

- Confirmed stakeholders:
  - Product Champion: Samantha Lee (me) — overall decisions and pilot scope
  - Eng Lead: Michael Dunn — will own ingestion and validation runs
  - Procurement/Contracts: Elena Rossi — will own SOW and procurement timelines

- We can provide a redacted representative dataset and a staging bucket (we'll share the access instructions in a follow-up).
- We have an internal security questionnaire — I attached it here (short answers) and marked a couple of items I expect you'll route to your security team.

Preferred kickoff: Tue Aug 3 10:00–10:30 PT works for our team. Please send an invite for that slot.

Also: on success criteria, Michael would like to add an operational requirement around throughput — can your team confirm supported concurrent request rates and a recommended batch strategy for our expected 200 reqs/min peak?

Thanks — looking forward.

Samantha — great, thanks for the quick confirmation and for the questionnaire. I'll own the technical kickoff on Aug 3 at 10:00 PT and will send a calendar invite in the next 10 minutes.

Agenda for the 30-min kickoff (target):
- 5 min introductions & roles/communication cadence
- 10 min infra checklist (access, SSO, staging bucket, data format)
- 10 min MAP worksheet walkthrough (ownership of success criteria + test dataset plan)
- 5 min next steps & deliverables (who does what by when)

Action items before the call:
- Samantha / Michael: drop the link to the staging bucket and a sample file (redacted) in reply or in the invite notes
- Elena: if possible, share the procurement timeline/any constraints so we can set realistic decision dates
- Rishi: please share the completed MAP worksheet (if you want a prefilled version) or confirm if you want me to own filling the infra checklist.

I'll include a short Zoom link and a shared Drive folder for artifacts. If anything changes on your side, ping me directly — my cell is in my signature.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodai.com | +1 (650) 555-0099

--
Marissa (cc) — adding you to keep visibility on the timeline and any exec-level asks that come up.
